notes: D23 states that Doctor Strange and America Chavez accidentally teleport to Earth-838 and are treated there as visitors from another universe. Doctor Strange and America Chavez are represented as confirmed travelers; no additional universe identity is inferred for America.

name_ja: ウェイド・ウィルソンのTVA召喚

notes: The official Deadpool & Wolverine screenplay depicts Wade in his Earth-10005 home setting being taken through a time door by TVA agents and assessed at the TVA; this event models only the identified TVA transfer and not unspecified variant destinations.
